name: order-proof-v2
question: The order-proof check, version 2, of a pushed manifest (charter, section 8): the CI push run completed, its plan job succeeded and every other job was skipped. It writes the receipt launch_v2.py requires before a draw, probe or measurement batch.
choices: docs/validation/v0.5.13/tools/order_proof_v2.py <manifest>; GitHub reads only; it records an upper estimate of its inbound bytes. Version 1 passed vacuously on ID-BEFORE (only the plan job existed, queued).

operations: gh api GET actions runs and jobs
